description: Add a logo/image watermark to an image. Provide image and logo URLs. Returns a download URL (valid 30 min).

image_url.description: URL of the image to watermark

logo_url.description: URL of the logo to use as watermark (PNG or WebP recommended)

scale.description: Logo scale as % of image width (5-80, default 20)

name: markly_watermark_logo
